prompt: At an uncontrolled T-intersection where one road terminates into a through street, who must yield?

options.text: The driver on the terminating road must yield to all through street traffic
The driver on the through street must yield to any vehicle making a left
Whichever driver reaches the intersection curb boundary first may proceed
The driver turning right must yield to all vehicles turning left into traffic
